fixes.explanation: That's Mary, friend. Luke says she "…sat at the Lord’s feet listening to His message." (Luke 10:39) She sits down close to Jesus and listens to Him. Sitting still and listening is what the text shows her doing.
True, baker. Martha says, "Tell her to help me!" (Luke 10:40) She says it right to Jesus. She asks Him to be the one to tell Mary.
